video.experimentalL4SRequestHint: Request the GeForce NOW L4S streaming feature on newly created sessions. This does not change browser WebRTC behavior by itself and may be ignored by the service or network path.
video.identifyAsSteamDeckHint: Identify as the Steam Deck GFN client to unlock Deck-specific resolutions and 90 FPS. Video options refresh automatically.
video.launchInConsoleModeHint: Start OpenNOW fullscreen with Controller Mode enabled, like GeForce NOW's TV mode. Sessions ask NVIDIA to launch games gamepad-friendly (big picture) while Console Mode or Controller Mode is active.

videoFilters.title: Video Filters
videoFilters.hint: GPU post-processing shaders applied to the decoded stream: sharpening, color grading, and film grain. Can also be adjusted live from the in-stream sidebar.
videoFilters.nativeUnavailable: Video filters do not apply while native streaming renders the video outside the app window.

codecDiagnostics.title: Codec Diagnostics
codecDiagnostics.description: Test which codecs your system can decode/encode and whether they use GPU or CPU
codecDiagnostics.linuxHardwareHint: Linux AppImage diagnostics use Chromium's WebRTC/MediaCapabilities report. Hardware decode depends on the Chromium build plus your distro GPU/video stack: x64 systems may need VA-API/NVIDIA VA-API drivers, while ARM V4L2 support depends on Chromium/Electron exposing that decoder.

game.title: Game
game.inGameLanguageHint: Language for in-game menus, subtitles, and audio (where supported)
game.persistInGameSettingsHint: Lets supported games keep graphics options changed inside the stream. Sent only for games that advertise NVIDIA in-game settings persistence support.

audio.microphoneDeviceHint: Select input device for voice chat

input.title: Input
input.gyroscopeControlsHint: Expose controller motion sensors for gyro aiming when the input backend supports it.
input.steamControllerCompatibilityModeHint: macOS only. Restores Chromium's older HID gamepad path for Steam Controller, but may reduce Xbox controller compatibility. Applies after app restart.
input.nativeCursorOverlayHint: WebRTC only. Uses NVIDIA's cursor_channel for a local cursor overlay; turn this off to leave cursor rendering to the server-side stream.
input.keyboardLayoutHint: Controls how your physical keyboard is mapped inside the remote session. Separate from the in-game language setting.
input.mouseSensitivityHint: Multiplier applied to mouse movement (1.00 = default)
input.mouseAcceleratorHint: Dynamic turn boost strength (1% = off-like, 150% = strongest).
input.shortcutConflictSidebar: Shortcut conflicts with the settings sidebar toggle.
input.shortcutHint: Click a field and press the keys to bind, or paste a shortcut ({{examples}}). Escape cancels focus. Full screen: {{fullscreen}}. Stop: {{stop}}. Mic: {{mic}}. Screenshot: {{screenshot}}. Recording: {{recording}}.

interface.appLanguageHint: Changes OpenNOW's interface language. English is used for untranslated strings.
interface.themeHint: Choose a light, dark, or system-matching theme.
interface.accentColorHint: Applies the selected accent across the standard desktop UI and persists between launches.
interface.hideStreamOverlayButtonsHint: Hide microphone, fullscreen, and end-session buttons while streaming.
interface.showStatsOnStreamLaunchHint: Automatically show the stats overlay when a new stream starts.
interface.hideServerSelectorHint: Skip the free-tier server selection dialog and always launch with OpenNOW's default routing.
interface.showAntiAfkIndicatorHint: Show the ANTI-AFK ON badge while Anti-AFK is enabled during streaming.
interface.autoFullScreenHint: Automatically enter fullscreen when connecting to or starting a session.
interface.controllerModeHint: Use a large-screen console-style shell with controller button hints and a horizontal library layout.
interface.consoleProfilePickerHint: Show the profile picker when console mode starts. Direct game launches are never interrupted.
interface.escapeExitsFullscreenHint: When enabled, pressing Escape exits fullscreen immediately. When disabled (default), Escape is forwarded to the game while pointer-locked; hold Escape ~1.5s to exit fullscreen.
interface.discordRichPresenceHint: Show the game you are streaming as your Discord activity, including elapsed time.
interface.posterSizeHint: Adjusts game posters in real time across the library.
interface.showSessionTimeRemainingInStatsOverlayHi: The session countdown appears in the in-stream sidebar by default. Enable this to also show it in the stats overlay.
interface.sessionElapsedCounterHint: Enable or disable the live session elapsed counter while streaming.
interface.sessionTimerReappearHint: How often the session timer pops back up while streaming (0 disables repeats).
interface.sessionTimerVisibleTimeHint: How long the session timer stays visible each time it appears.
interface.sessionTimerDisabledHint: Disabling the session elapsed counter stops the live elapsed timer from rendering at all. Remaining playtime indicators stay unchanged.

about.backgroundChecksOn: Packaged builds check GitHub Releases in the background.
about.backgroundChecksOff: Background update checks are off until you manually check.

about.updateChannelNightlyHint: Nightly builds may be less reliable. Switching channels immediately checks for an available update.
about.automaticallyCheckForUpdatesOnHint: When on, packaged builds check GitHub Releases in the background after startup and periodically while OpenNOW is running.
about.automaticallyCheckForUpdatesOffHint: When off, OpenNOW stays on the current version unless you use the manual update buttons below.
about.exportLogsHint: Download debug logs with sensitive data redacted for privacy
about.exportLogsFailed: Failed to export logs. Please try again.

about.deleteCacheConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete all cached data? This will clear all game metadata, images, and library information.
about.cacheCleared: Cache cleared successfully. The app will refresh on next startup.
about.deleteCacheFailed: Failed to delete cache. Please try again.
about.whatsNewHint: View the release notes for the current version of OpenNOW.
about.errorReportingHint: Sends anonymous crash reports and app opens (install ID, version, OS). Never includes your NVIDIA account, games library, or gameplay.
about.sendFeedbackHint: Share a bug report or idea with the OpenNOW team.

nativeStreamer.title: Native Streamer
nativeStreamer.nativeStreamingHint: Native streaming is experimental and may have platform-specific bugs, glitches, or fallbacks to Chromium/WebRTC. Enable it only if you are comfortable testing the GStreamer-based desktop streamer for new sessions.
nativeStreamer.enablePromptBody: The native streamer is still experimental. Internal mode keeps video inside the OpenNOW window; external floating mode is available as a fallback in settings.
nativeStreamer.enablePromptNewSessions: Native streaming applies to new sessions only.
nativeStreamer.enablePromptShortcuts: In internal mode, OpenNOW shortcuts stay available. External floating mode captures input in its own window.
nativeStreamer.enablePromptAltTab: If you use external floating mode, Alt+Tab back into OpenNOW to exit the stream or use app shortcuts.
nativeStreamer.showNativeStreamerStatsHint: Display the native streamer's own diagnostics overlay during native sessions.
nativeStreamer.statusDefaultHint: OpenNOW will check the bundled GStreamer streamer when this tab opens.
nativeStreamer.runtimeDefaultHint: Packaged Windows/macOS builds auto-detect a bundled runtime next to the native streamer. Linux uses distro packages.
nativeStreamer.linuxRuntimeHint: Linux AppImage/private GStreamer bundling is intentionally not used by default because VAAPI/V4L2/Vulkan plugins must match the host distro and GPU driver stack. .deb packages declare Debian/Ubuntu dependencies automatically.
nativeStreamer.noCodecsAvailable: No compatible codecs were detected for this backend.
nativeStreamer.probingBackends: Probing the installed GPU drivers and GStreamer plugins…
nativeStreamer.capabilityProbeHint: Refresh the streamer status to probe the video backends supported by this PC.
nativeStreamer.backendUnavailableOnPc: This backend is not supported by the installed GPU drivers and GStreamer plugins.
nativeStreamer.videoPathDefaultHint: OpenNOW will show the active hardware decode path after GStreamer is detected.
nativeStreamer.directxBackendHint: Applies to the next native streamer process. Unsupported choices are disabled from the live capability probe. Auto selects the best compatible path.
nativeStreamer.framePacingHint: Lowest Latency avoids G-Sync pacing and is best for mouse feel. Smooth G-Sync can reduce tearing, but may cap rendering to the monitor refresh rate.
nativeStreamer.renderModeHint: Internal (default) embeds native video in the OpenNOW window. External keeps the floating GStreamer window for testing/fallback. Change applies to the next native streamer process.
nativeStreamer.renderModeInternalOnlyHint: This platform uses Internal (one window) only. Keyboard, mouse, and controller input stay in Electron and are forwarded over IPC. External floating mode is Windows-only.
nativeStreamer.transportModeHint: WebRTC is the supported path. NVST (experimental) uses classic RTSPS + UDP video (Moonlight-hypothesis scaffold) while keyboard/mouse/controller stay on WebRTC SCTP datachannels. First live sessions may need SRTP/pcap validation.
nativeStreamer.transportModeWindowsOnlyHint: NVST transport is Windows-only for now. This platform always uses WebRTC.

telemetryConsent.title: Help improve OpenNOW?
telemetryConsent.body: OpenNOW can send anonymous diagnostics so we can find crashes and understand how many installs are active.
telemetryConsent.sendsErrors: Sends crash details, app version, and OS information
telemetryConsent.sendsAppOpens: Sends an anonymous signal when the app opens (for install counts)
telemetryConsent.sendsAnonymousId: Uses a random install ID — not linked to your name or email
telemetryConsent.neverSendsAccount: Never sends your NVIDIA account, tokens, or library
telemetryConsent.neverSendsGameplay: Never records gameplay, streams, or session content
telemetryConsent.changeLater: You can change this anytime in Settings → About.
